title: 晨光树洞书桌

prompts.initial_prompt:
Use the three attached original early Chinese Mole Manor Flash-game backgrounds as direct visual references. Recompose their drawing language into ONE DIFFERENT ORIGINAL interior: a cheerful morning study nook inside a hollow tree, a 16:10 wide desktop pet game background, edge-to-edge opaque illustration. This is an art-direction task, not a copy of any reference layout. Make it look plausibly drawn by the same early Chinese Flash browser-game background team.

Scene design: a very large broad honey-yellow wooden desk fills the entire foreground and lower 60 percent, with its clean flat tabletop available as the pet's standing surface. At the back is a simple curving apricot tree wall. Put a slightly lopsided round wooden window in the upper-left third with clear cyan sky, two chunky white clouds and yellow-green tree crowns outside. At the far back right place THREE large simple books leaning on one another and ONE broad-leaf plant in a squat pot. One small plain leaf-shaped wall ornament is enough. Few objects; large clear silhouettes; playful handmade slightly wonky proportions and gentle elevated toy-stage perspective. Do not put a chair or furniture in the central standing area.

MATCH THE REFERENCES' CONCRETE DRAWING METHOD: clean flat 2D Flash vector-looking cartoon illustration exported as a PNG; continuous warm dark-brown outlines, irregular confident curves with occasional short angular cuts; only 2 to 4 broad HARD-EDGED solid color shapes per material. Tree wood is large apricot/yellow/brown shapes with only a few long triangular patches, no detailed continuous grain. Leaves are simple layered green cutout shapes. No surface texture. Morning sunlight is ONE pale-yellow flat hard-edged patch, not a lighting effect. Depth comes from overlap and scale, with simple flat short shadows. Bright local colors and low visual noise, as in the references. Do not introduce a new Western children's-book rendering style.

Production composition: keep the central 55 percent of the desk from 40 to 87 percent image height open, smooth, bright honey-yellow with very sparse detail so the unchanged original red/pink/yellow/blue Ram sprite can stand there. Keep the bottom 16 percent especially calm for a toolbar; do not put a desk edge, big dark shadow, books or plants through the toolbar area. Keep important details inside a centered 4:3 safe area because this wide image will crop to different desktop windows. The room must fill the entire image, including corners; do not inherit transparent or black outside margins from reference 2 or 3.

No people, no pets, no animals, no Ram, no faces on objects, no lettering, no text, no watermark, no logos, no UI panels or buttons. Avoid watercolor, Western storybook styling, oil-painting or brush marks, paper grain, wood texture, gradients over the whole image, realistic light, ambient occlusion, bloom, blur, atmospheric haze, volumetric sunbeams, depth of field, 3D rendering, fantasy tavern decor, little dense ornaments, dense linework, or kawaii chibi characters. The result should be simple and unmistakably consistent with the three supplied original Flash references.
prompts.refinement_prompt:
Edit the FIRST image, the newly designed morning tree-desk scene, while retaining its current window/books/plant positions and its huge clear tabletop. The SECOND and THIRD images are original early Chinese Mole Manor Flash-game references for the drawing method only. Do not copy their composition.

Make the first image's rendering noticeably flatter and simpler to match the originals. Replace the large smooth yellow glow and every broad continuous lighting gradient on the tabletop with THREE clean flat solid color fields: honey-yellow base, one pale yellow hard-edged light patch at left, one slightly darker angular patch at the far edge. The central lower desktop must be almost a single solid yellow field. Simplify the tree wall into 2-3 broad solid apricot/brown shapes with sparse long triangular wood patches. Remove soft highlights from the window frame and pot; use short hard-edged light shapes instead. Preserve the original image's confident warm dark-brown contours, slight irregular curves and playful proportions. Reduce small internal details on the leaves and books. The result must look like a clean flat 2008 Chinese Flash browser-game background rather than a painterly illustration or a modern soft 3D cartoon.

Keep the same wide composition, bright clear cyan sky and yellow-green trees, three simple books and one broad-leaf plant on the far right, and the plain little hanging leaf. Keep all objects away from the central lower standing area and bottom toolbar area. No furniture through the center. No characters, pets, animals, faces, text, letters, buttons, logos or UI. No texture, brush marks, grain, blur, depth of field, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, volumetric light or photographic materials. Fill the rectangular image completely with opaque artwork; retain clear empty space for the unchanged original Ram sprite.

iterations.purpose: Flatten light and material fields; keep layout
